newsitem.title: USA: Nicollet Processing stake held by Okabena.
newsitem.headline: Nicollet Processing stake held by Okabena.

text.p: Okabena Partnerhip K, a Minnesota general partnership, said Thursday it holds a 6.4 percent stake, or 215,000 common shares, in Nicollet Processing Engineering Inc
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership said it bought the stake between March 18 and December 18 at prices ranging from $1.563 to $4.625 per share.
The partnership holds the stake in Nicollet for investment purposes, according to the filing.
